brief_summary: Using the Libre during the TOC with persons with T2D will improve patient glucose monitoring and satisfaction, which can potentially lead to an improvement in glycemic control and hospital utilization. This study aims to assess this with inpatients using insulin.
brief_title: Feasibility of Using the CGM During TOC From in Persons With T2D Using Insulin

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Persons with T2DM
* Persons on atleast 3 injections of insulin/day
* Persons whose insurance will cover the device

Exclusion Criteria:

* Persons with adhesive allergy
* Pregnant women
* Persons with CKD 4/5 or on dialysis

official_title: The Feasibility of Using the FreeStyle Libre Flash Glucose Monitoring System During the Transition of Care (TOC) From Inpatient to Outpatient in Persons With Type 2 Diabetes (T2D) Using Basal/Bolus Insulin

sites.facility: Northwell Health North Shore University Hospital
